goal_checks.notes: WorkspaceShell (and its Body) accept an optional `children` and render it in the main area; without children the previous placeholder (title + goal) still renders, so /w is unchanged. The route passes the composed view as children, so the shell never imports document/highlight (I3 respected).

src/app/w/[workspaceId]/workspace-document.tsx is the only place document and highlight meet; it composes DocumentViewer with HighlightedPage through the renderPage slot and imports both feature barrels. verify:arch's I4 scan finds no useAppSelector/useAppDispatch under src/app, and the component holds only the armed-tool useState.

The toolbar exposes Select / Rectangle / Freehand mapped to MarqueeTool | null; the composition test proves the chosen tool reaches HighlightedPage (and therefore the marquee leaf) and that Select disarms it.

workspace-document.test.tsx renders the real component with the viewer and page mocked, asserting the page args flow through renderPage and the tool arms/disarms. No live stack is needed for this proof.
